title: Plane Fight Arcade
description: Pilot an ace fighter jet through classic vertical bullet-hell skies—grab twin-wing spread upgrades, trigger screen-clearing bombs, and smash giant airships.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen to pilot your jet, collect weapon upgrades, and dodge enemy bullet curtains.

zh-CN.title: 雷霆飞机大战
zh-CN.description: 国民经典竖版弹幕雷霆飞机大战：单指驾驭王牌战机穿梭密集弹雨，吃道具暴走满屏散射轰爆巨型母舰！
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕拖动战机灵活走位躲弹幕，拾取火力强化道具击溃敌机编队与 Boss。
